# Psalm 94 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** LORD, God of justice — God of justice, reveal yourself!

**2** Stand up, Judge of the earth! Give the arrogant what they have coming!

**3** How long, LORD? How long will the wicked get to celebrate?

**4** They pour out arrogant words; every evildoer is full of themselves.

**5** They trample your people, LORD, and oppress the nation that belongs to you.

**6** They murder widows and foreigners; they kill orphans.

**7** And they say, 'The LORD isn't watching. The God of Jacob doesn't notice.'

**8** Pay attention, you ignorant people! You fools — when will you ever learn?

**9** The one who designed the ear — can't he hear? The one who shaped the eye — can't he see?

**10** The one who holds nations accountable — won't he punish? The one who gives people knowledge —

**11** the LORD knows exactly what people are thinking — and he knows it amounts to nothing.

**12** How blessed is the person you train, LORD — the one you teach from your word.

**13** You give them peace during hard times while a trap is being prepared for the wicked.

**14** The LORD will not abandon his people; he will never walk away from those who belong to him.

**15** Justice will eventually return to the courtroom, and every honest person will stand behind it.

**16** Who will stand up for me against these evildoers? Who will fight for me against these criminals?

**17** If the LORD hadn't helped me, I would have quickly ended up in the silence of death.

**18** The moment I said, 'I'm slipping!' your faithful love caught me, LORD.

**19** When anxiety floods my mind, your comfort calms my soul.

**20** Can a corrupt government be your ally — one that writes injustice into law?

**21** They gang up against good people and sentence the innocent to death.

**22** But the LORD is my fortress; my God is the rock where I take shelter.

**23** He will turn their own evil back on them and destroy them with their own wickedness. The LORD our God will wipe them out.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **94:19**: This verse is pure pastoral care: 'When anxiety floods my mind, your comfort calms my soul.' It validates the reality of anxiety while pointing to its remedy.

- **94:20**: One of the most politically relevant verses in the Psalms: Can a corrupt government that writes injustice into law really be on God's side? The answer is a thundering no.

— PNEUMA
